description: This PHP source file defines the class DataGroupPermissionCollection, which extends the AttributeBag class. It provides a method to convert a collection of resource permissions into an array representation suitable for external use.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionCollection
classes.description: A collection class for handling resource permissions associated with data groups, providing serialization to an array format.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the collection of ResourcePermission objects into an array where each data group has a set of boolean flags indicating permissions.
